# what: does the module DXC emits for repro.hlsl fail the validator built

==============================================================================
# emit DXIL with validation disabled, so the optimizer's output survives
$ <repo>/build/Debug/bin/dxc.exe -E main -T cs_6_0 -Vd -Fc artifact-main-debug-Vd.ll -Fo artifact-main-debug-Vd.dxil repro.hlsl
[exit] 0 (0x00000000)
--- stdout ---

--- stderr ---


==============================================================================
# validate that same DXIL with dxv.exe, which is built from this repo's source

--- stdout ---

note: at '%15 = phi float addrspace(3)* [ %22, %19 ], [ %8, %10 ]' in block '#6' of function 'main'.
Validation failed.
